users_login_present.name: users_login_present
users_login_present.value: "users"."username" is not null or "users"."phone_hash" is not null

auth_sessions_previous_rotated.name: auth_sessions_previous_rotated
auth_sessions_previous_rotated.value: "auth_sessions"."previous_refresh_hash" is null or "auth_sessions"."rotated_at" is not null

idempotency_keys_completed_fields.name: idempotency_keys_completed_fields
idempotency_keys_completed_fields.value:
("idempotency_keys"."status" = 'completed' and "idempotency_keys"."response_status" is not null and "idempotency_keys"."response_enc" is not null)
        or ("idempotency_keys"."status" <> 'completed' and "idempotency_keys"."response_status" is null and "idempotency_keys"."response_enc" is null)

integration_outbox_attempts_range.name: integration_outbox_attempts_range
integration_outbox_attempts_range.value: "integration_outbox"."attempts" between 0 and "integration_outbox"."max_attempts" and "integration_outbox"."max_attempts" between 1 and 20 and ("integration_outbox"."status" <> 'pending' or "integration_outbox"."attempts" < "integration_outbox"."max_attempts")

integration_outbox_lease_pair.name: integration_outbox_lease_pair
integration_outbox_lease_pair.value: ("integration_outbox"."status" = 'processing') = ("integration_outbox"."locked_until" is not null and "integration_outbox"."lock_token" is not null)
